description: South Korea business days: count working days between two dates, or find the date N business days later, skipping weekends and Korean public holidays (2025-2027 table incl. substitute holidays).

days.description: Business days to add, add mode; default 1

includeStart.description: Count the start date itself, count mode; default true

mode.description: count days between startDate and endDate (default) or add N business days to startDate

name: business_days
